BiblicalUsage: Sethur was the son of Michael, the spy sent from the tribe of Asher to search out the land. His name means hidden, and he is named once, in the list of the twelve spies.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a man named once is still known by God, and his name is kept because he walked where God sent him.
